name: Internet Society
body: HSTS is preloaded, an Organization entity is published, and articles carry author and date. But framing is limited only by X-Frame-Options: ALLOW-FROM, which current browsers ignore, so the page can be framed.
lesson: Replace ALLOW-FROM with Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' plus the one partner you allow.
summary: www.internetsociety.org scores 85 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 15 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: 26 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 26 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /our-work/connectivity/, /our-work/how-the-internet-works/, /our-work/internet-governance/, /our-work/internet-policy/ and 6 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 20 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / Organization lacks url, /about-internet-society/ Organization lacks url, /mission/ Organization lacks url and 17 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 9 pages took longer than 1.8 s
fix.evidence: /about-internet-society/ (2504 ms), /about-internet-society/team/ (1908 ms), /our-work/connectivity/ (2516 ms), /our-work/how-the-internet-works/ (2135 ms) and 5 more.
fix.fix: Profile those templates; they are slower than the rest of the site.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
